name: Cable Low-to-High Woodchop
steps: Stand sideways to a low cable with both hands on the handle near your inside hip and your knees softly bent.
Turn away from the machine and sweep the handle diagonally toward the outside of your far shoulder.
Guide the handle back down to your inside hip.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Turn your feet with your hips so your knees follow your toes.
Keep your arms mostly straight so your trunk powers the diagonal lift.
